runs.text: Spain, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: Spain is stolen land. Before Spain, the Romans called it Hispania. Before the Romans, the Iberians. Decolonize Spain! Give it back to the Iberians! Finding two: Spain holds two cities in Africa, Ceuta and Melilla. Behind fences six metres high. Finding three: the Canary Islands. Conquered from the Guanches in the fourteen hundreds. Finding four: in twenty nineteen, Spain jailed Catalan leaders for up to thirteen years, over a referendum. Finding five: Valencia says paella with chorizo is a war crime. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. Spain isn't an apartheid state. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. So, one more time.
